checks: nonadjacent dirty rows publish once after the complete frame is painted
one-row updates still copy only one row
terminal content and search overlay share one visible copy
bulk output ending in silence publishes the final real pixels without an external wakeup
idle hidden-cursor windows have no recurring 8 ms repaint wakeup
one shared broker updates the flooding view while XTEST echo and broker input render in the other view before flood ends
a force/expose paint of the old screen does not lose the subsequent interactive response
synchronized output and Expose retain the committed pixels until explicit release
a quiet synchronized frame commits at the 150 ms timeout; repeated begin does not restart it
a synchronized begin/end in one small write publishes its complete final pixels
scrollback and its return-to-live prompt share one visible copy
real XTEST keyboard events distinguish Ctrl+Shift+I and retain Ctrl+I and Ctrl+tilde control mappings
Num Lock stays silent in legacy mode; real keypad digits, Insert semantics and explicit enhanced lock reporting are verified
vertical and horizontal wheel input has distinct SGR press codes and no release reports
extra button press/release reports retain button identity; report records physical XTEST versus synthetic XSendEvent coverage
held extra-button state survives motion and clears on release, including X11 buttons lacking core state-mask bits
press ownership remains stable when Shift changes before a primary or extra-button release
focus loss clears held extra-button state before focus returns, motion, and release
mode 9 filters input correctly, follows SGR selection, and its reset cannot cancel active mode 1000
custom keyboard and mouse actions consume their bound events and overlay text while mouse reporting is enabled
shifted punctuation bindings consume their press, release and palette input using the active XKB layout
real zoom/reset shortcuts change glyph cell metrics and matching PTY grid, preserve pixel window size and emit no key press/release bytes; default non-US plus and custom overrides are covered
Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move between real raw PTYs without leaking a consumed key release after focus changes

scope: Private Xvfb with real PTY, XTEST, XCopyArea tracing and window pixel checks; not a physical display or vblank measurement.
